name: Quick unions
function: The threaded collar joints between stack components and lubricator sections, sealed with an O-ring, made up by hand with a bar or by a hydraulic collar.

tabs.overview: A pin with the seal and a box with a coarse thread; the collar turns a few turns to make up. Hydraulic quick unions make up and release under remote control so no one stands at the stack. Every union is a test point: the stack is retested after any union is remade.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the stack; O-rings replaced on a schedule and whenever cut.
tabs.safety: Never break a union with pressure on the stack; the quick test sub lets the stack be tested without well pressure after a remake.
tabs.evidence: Public pressure control equipment catalogs and service descriptions (S6, S7, S13); API RP 67 (S14) and API RP 19B (S15) for the perforating side; field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test the stack before opening the swab valve; bleed to zero before breaking any union.
Hands clear of sheaves, the drum, and quick unions during make-up.
